name: "Charge!"
description: Elite Shout. All allies within earshot lose the Crippled condition. For 5...13 seconds, these allies move 33% faster.

sourceCampaigns.Dahgar, the Eye of Flame: Prophecies and Eye of the North

concise: Elite Shout. (5...13 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 33% faster. Initial effect: these allies lose the Crippled condition.

name: "Fear Me!"
description: Shout. All nearby foes lose 2...6 Energy. For 1...15 seconds, your melee attacks gain +5...30% chance of a critical hit against stationary foes.
concise: Shout. (1...15 seconds.) You have +5...30% chance of a critical hit with melee attacks against stationary foes. Initial effect: nearby foes lose 2...6 Energy.

name: "For Great Justice!"
description: Shout. For 20 seconds, whenever you gain adrenaline, you gain 100% more.
concise: Shout. (20 seconds.) You gain 100% more adrenaline.

name: "I Will Avenge You!"
description: Shout. For each dead ally, you gain 10 seconds of +3...7 Health regeneration and your attack speed increases by 25%.
concise: Shout. You have +3...7 Health regeneration and attack 25% faster (10 seconds for each dead ally).

name: "I Will Survive!"
description: Shout. You gain +3 Health regeneration for each condition you are suffering. This regeneration expires after 5...11 seconds.
concise: Shout. (5...11 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each condition on you.

name: "Shields Up!"
description: Shout. For 5...11 seconds, you and all party members within earshot gain +60 armor against incoming projectile attacks.
concise: Shout. (5...11 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +60 armor against projectile attacks.

name: "To the Limit!"
description: Shout. For each foe within earshot (maximum 1...6), you gain one strike of adrenaline. For 10...20 seconds, your maximum Health is increased by 10...60.
concise: Shout. (10...20 seconds.) You have +10...60 maximum Health. Initial effect: you gain one strike of adrenaline for each foe within earshot (maximum 1...6).

name: "Together as One!"
description: Elite Shout. For 3...15 seconds, all party members near you or near your pet deal +5...15 additional damage with attacks and gain +1...7 Health regeneration. PvE Skill
concise: Elite Shout. (3...15 seconds.) All party members near you or your pet deal +5...15 damage and gain +1...7 Health regeneration. PvE Skill

name: "Victory Is Mine!"
description: Elite Shout. You gain 10...68 Health and 3...7 Energy for each condition suffered by target foe.
concise: Elite Shout. You gain 10...68 Health and 3...7 Energy for each condition on target foe.

name: "Watch Yourself!"
description: Shout. Party members within earshot gain +5...25 armor for 10 seconds. This shout ends after 10 incoming attacks.
concise: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +5...25 armor. Ends after 10 incoming attacks.

name: Aegis
description: Enchantment Spell. For 6...15 seconds, all party members within earshot have a 50% chance to block attacks.
concise: Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members within earshot (6...15 seconds.) 50% chance to block.

name: Aftershock
description: Spell. Nearby foes are struck for 15...85 earth damage. Knocked down foes are struck for 15...85 additional earth damage.
concise: Spell. Deals 15...85 earth damage to nearby foes. Deals 15...85 more earth damage to knocked down foes.

name: Air Attunement
description: Enchantment Spell. For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Air. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill whenever you use Air Magic.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (36...60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost when you use an Air Magic skill.

triggers: You or ally uses a skill

name: Amity
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 4...12 seconds, adjacent foes cannot attack. For each foe, Amity ends if that foe takes damage.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (4...12 seconds.) Foes adjacent to you cannot attack. Ends on any foes that take damage.

name: Animate Bone Fiend
description: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1...17 bone fiend. Bone fiends can attack at range.
concise: Spell. Creates a level 1...17 bone fiend that can attack at range. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Bone Horror
description: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1...17 bone horror.
concise: Spell. Creates a level 1...17 bone horror. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Bone Minions
description: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate two level 0...12 bone minions.
concise: Spell. Creates two level 0...12 bone minions. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Antidote Signet
description: Signet. Cleanse yourself of Poison, Disease, Blindness, and one additional condition.
concise: Signet. Remove Poison, Disease, Blindness, and one additional condition from yourself.

name: Apply Poison
description: Preparation. For 24 seconds, foes struck by your physical attacks become Poisoned for 3...15 seconds.
concise: Preparation. (24 seconds.) Your physical attacks inflict Poisoned condition (3...15 seconds).

description: Hex Spell. For 5...15 seconds, spells cast by target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to cast. When this hex ends, you gain 1...7 energy.
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (5...15 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. End effect: you gain 1...7 energy.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Arcane Echo becomes the next spell you use (20 seconds). This enchantment ends if you use any skill that is not a spell.

description: Spell. For 5...35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe, and Arcane Thievery is replaced by that spell.
concise: Spell. (5...35 seconds.) Disables one random spell. This skill becomes that spell.

name: Armor of Earth
description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, you gain 24...60 armor, but move 50...14% slower.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) You have +24...60 armor. You move 50...14% slower.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (10...34 seconds.) You gain +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (8...20 seconds.) You have +10...40 armor and move 33% faster.

concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3 seconds.) Target ally gains 50...100% more Health when healed and takes 5...50% less damage.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) You gain 0...1 Energy and are healed for 200...500% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (20...44 seconds.) You have +2 Blood Magic and Curses. Sacrifice 50% more Health than normal.

concise: Axe Attack. Deals +4...16 damage and inflicts Crippled condition (15 seconds) if target foe has a Deep Wound.

concise: Axe Attack. Deals +5...25 damage and inflicts Weakness condition (20 seconds) if target foe has a Deep Wound.

concise: Stance. (8...20 seconds.) You cannot be knocked-down and do not take extra damage from critical hits.

name: Balthazar's Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, foes adjacent to target ally take 10...30 holy damage each second.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Deals 10...30 holy damage each second to foes adjacent to target ally.

concise: Enchantment Spell. Target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy when taking damage.

name: Bane Signet

concise: Signet. Deals 30...60 holy damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is attacking.

name: Banish
description: Spell. Target foe takes 20...65 holy damage. This spell does double damage to summoned creatures.
concise: Spell. Deals 20...65 holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

concise: Signet. Target and adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding (3...15 seconds).

concise: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 7...23 piercing damage. Inflicts Crippled and Bleeding conditions (3...25 seconds). Easily interrupted.

concise: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Target foe takes 4...16 damage whenever it takes physical damage.

concise: Elite Bow Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Hits 5 foes adjacent to your target. All your preparations are removed.

concise: Elite Stance. (5...20 seconds.) You move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from your attacks. Ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.

concise: Stance. (8...14 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and gain 100% more adrenaline. Ends if you use a skill.

concise: Enchantment Spell. Monk enchantments you cast last 10...35% longer.

concise: Signet. You gain 3 Energy for each enchantment you are maintaining. You cannot gain more than 3...24 Energy in this way.

concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) +3...6 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.

concise: Stance. (5...11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Gain 5 Energy for each melee attack blocked. Ends if you use a skill.

concise: Pet Attack. Deals +5...35 damage. Deals +5...35 more damage if target foe is under 50% Health.

concise: Elite Stance. (1...7 seconds.) You move 50% faster. Causes knock-down if you hit a moving foe in melee. Ends if you use a skill.

name: Bull's Strike
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits a moving foe, you strike for +5...30 damage, and your target is knocked down.
concise: Melee Attack. Deals +5...30 damage and causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

name: Call of Haste

concise: Shout. (30 seconds.) Your pet moves and attacks 33% faster.

concise: Shout. (120 seconds.) Your pet has 5...20 damage reduction.

concise: Spell. Deals 10...85 lightning damage. Also hits two foes near your target. 25% armor penetration.

description: Skill. Your animal companion will travel with you if you have Charm Animal equipped and have at least 8 points in Beast Mastery.
concise: Skill. Your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. Failure unless Beast Mastery 8 or higher.

concise: Skill. Your pet gains 40...120 Health. Resurrects your pet (10...58% Health). If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 fire damage. No effect unless your weapon deals fire damage.

name: Conjure Frost
description: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a cold weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5...20 cold damage.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 cold damage. No effect unless your weapon deals cold damage.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 lightning damage. No effect unless your weapon deals lightning damage.

concise: Spell. Removes all hexes; +10 armor for each Necromancer hex removed (8...20 seconds). Cannot self-target.

concise: Hammer Attack. Deals +1...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition if target foe is knocked-down (5...20 seconds).

concise: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted. Foe suffers 15...75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.

concise: Spell. Deals 10...70 damage to all foes adjacent to you. Those foes lose all conditions and take 5...15 damage for each condition removed.

name: Cyclone Axe
description: Axe Attack. Perform a spinning axe attack striking for +4...12 damage to all adjacent opponents.
concise: Axe Attack. Deals +4...12 damage to all foes adjacent to you.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 5...50 damage to adjacent foes whenever target ally sacrifices Health. Damage cost: you lose 5...20 Health.

concise: Enchantment Spell. Enchants party members (5 seconds). These party members gain one strike of adrenaline each time they hit with an attack. 50% failure chance unless Blood Magic 5 or more.

name: Dark Pact
description: Spell. Deal 20...60 shadow damage to target foe.
concise: Spell. Deals 20...60 damage.

name: Deadly Riposte
description: Skill. For 8 seconds, while you have a sword equipped, you block the next melee attack against you, and your attacker is struck for 15...90 damage and begins Bleeding for 3...25 seconds.
concise: Skill. (8 seconds.) You block the next melee attack and your attacker takes 15...90 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (3...25 seconds). No effect unless you have a sword equipped.

name: Death Nova

concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 26...100 damage and inflicts Poisoned condition (15 seconds) on adjacent foes if target ally dies.

name: Deathly Chill

concise: Spell. Deals 5...50 cold damage. Deals 5...50 more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.

name: Deathly Swarm

concise: Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and deals 30...90 cold damage. Hits two additional foes in the area.

name: Debilitating Shot

concise: Stance. (1...6 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block attacks. Adjacent foes suffer Bleeding (5...15 seconds) when you block a projectile attack.

name: Defy Pain

concise: Elite Skill. (20 seconds.) You have +90...300 maximum Health, +20 armor, and take -1...10 less damage.

description: Elite Signet. Heal target ally for 20...80 Health. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer spell that targets an ally heals for an additional 20...100 Health.
concise: Elite Signet. Heals for 20...80. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer spell that targets an ally heals for +20...100 Health.

name: Boon of Creation
description: Enchantment Spell. For 15...60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, you gain 5...50 Health and 1...6 Energy.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (15...60 seconds.) You gain 5...50 Health and 1...6 Energy whenever you create a creature.

name: Brambles
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures that are knocked down in its range take 5 damage and begin Bleeding for 5...20 seconds. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Knocked-down creatures take 5 damage and begin Bleeding (5...20 seconds). Does not affect spirits.

name: Breath of Fire
description: Spell. Create Breath of Fire at target foe's current location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 10...40 fire damage each second.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...40 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

name: Broad Head Arrow
description: Elite Bow Attack. You shoot a broad head arrow that moves slower than normal. If it hits, target foe is Dazed for 5...20 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell that spell is interrupted.
concise: Elite Bow Attack. Slow-moving arrow. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Brutal Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. Give target ally a Brutal Weapon for 10...40 seconds. The bearer's weapon strikes for +5...15 damage as long as the bearer is under no enchantments.
concise: Weapon Spell. (10...40 seconds.) Attacks deal +5...15 damage. No effect while target ally is enchanted.

name: Burning Speed
description: Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you are set on fire and move 30...45% faster. When Burning Speed ends, all adjacent foes are set on fire for 3...9 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds.) You move 30...45% faster. You suffer from Burning (7 seconds). End effect: inflicts Burning condition (3...9 seconds) on adjacent foes.

name: Caltrops
description: Spell. Target foe and all foes adjacent to your target are Crippled and Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. Caltrops has half the normal range.
concise: Half Range Spell. Inflicts Crippled and Bleeding conditions (5...15 seconds) on target and adjacent foes.

name: Celestial Haste
description: Spell. For 15 seconds, your entire party has 50% fast casting and all skills recharge 25% faster.
concise: Spell. (15 seconds.) Affects all party members. 50% faster casting. 25% faster skill recharge.

name: Celestial Stance
description: Skill. For 15 seconds, your entire party has a 75% chance to block attacks and +3 Health regeneration.
concise: Skill. (15 seconds.) Affects all party members. 75% chance to block. +3 Health regeneration.

description: Skill. Create a celestial storm at target foe's location that lasts for 15 seconds. Each second, all foes in the area take 40 fire damage, 40 cold damage, 40 lightning damage, and 40 earth damage.
concise: Skill. Deals 40 damage of each elemental type each second (15 seconds). Hits all foes in the area of target's initial location.

concise: Skill. Archemorous and Saint Viktor are summoned from the spirit realm.

description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5...95 lightning damage. That foe is struck for an additional 5...35 lightning damage if you are holding an item.
concise: Spell. Deals 5...95 lightning damage. Deals 5...35 additional lightning damage if you are holding an item.

name: Churning Earth

concise: Spell. Deals 10...40 earth damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. Causes knock-down to foes moving faster than normal.

description: Elite Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes take 10...65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit or holding a bundle item, you gain 10 Energy.
concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...65 lightning damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 10 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit or holding a bundle item.

name: Complicate
description: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for target foe and all foes in the area for an additional 5...12 seconds.
concise: Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+5...12 seconds) for target foe and all foes in the area.

concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). All arrows deal fire damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

concise: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals 15...60 earth damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) if target foe is moving.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (4...10 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Renewal: every time you land a critical hit.

concise: Skill. (10...35 seconds.) You have +3...15% chance to land a critical hit. You gain 1 Energy whenever you land a critical hit.

concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3...17 seconds.) Your critical hits remove an enchantment. Removal cost: lose 10...3 Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.

concise: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +15...35 damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). No effect unless target foe is knocked-down.

concise: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Deals 20...70 damage to creatures in range that reach 0 Energy. Does not affect spirits.

If your companion is dead, it's resurrected with 50% Health. If you have this skill equipped, your companion will travel with you.
concise: Elite Skill. (15 seconds.) Your pet's attacks steal 1...20 Health. Initial effect: heals you and your pet for 20...104; resurrects your pet (50% Health) if dead. If you have this skill equipped, your pet will travel with you.

name: Healing Burst
description: Elite Spell. Target ally is healed for 20...120. All party members in earshot of your target gain Health equal to the Divine Favor bonus from this spell. Your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
concise: Elite Spell. Heals for 20...120. Party members in earshot of your target gain Health equal to the Divine Favor bonus. Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).

name: Healing Light
description: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 40...120 Health. If your target has an enchantment, you gain 1...3 Energy.
concise: Elite Spell. Heals for 40...120. You gain 1...3 Energy if target ally is enchanted.

name: Healing Whisper
description: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 40...100. This spell has half the normal range.
concise: Half Range Spell. Heals for 40...100. Cannot self-target.

name: Heart of Shadow
description: Spell. You are healed for 30...150. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
concise: Spell. You are healed for 30...150 and you Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

name: Heaven's Delight
description: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60 points.
concise: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60.

name: Hex Eater Signet
description: Signet. Target touched ally and up to 2...5 adjacent allies each lose one hex. You gain 1...4 Energy for each hex removed this way.
concise: Touch Signet. Removes a hex from target and 2...5 adjacent allies. Removal effect: you gain 1...4 Energy for each hex removed.

name: Horns of the Ox
description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Horns of the Ox strikes for +1...11 damage. If struck foe is not adjacent to any allies, that foe is knocked down.
concise: Dual Attack. Deals +1...11 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is not adjacent to any of its allies. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Icy Prism
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe has a Water Magic hex, Icy Prism deals +15...75 cold damage to all other nearby foes.
concise: Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage. Deals +15...75 cold damage to other nearby foes if target has a Water Magic hex.

name: Icy Veins
description: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...90 cold damage. For 10...35 seconds, if target foe dies all nearby foes are struck for 20...110 cold damage.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (10...35 seconds.) Deals 20...110 cold damage to nearby foes if target foe dies. Initial effect: deals 10...90 cold damage.

name: Illusion of Pain
description: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe has -3...10 Health degeneration and takes 3...10 damage each second. When Illusion of Pain ends, that foe is healed for 36...120.
concise: Hex Spell. (8 seconds.) Causes -3...10 Health degeneration and target foe takes 3...10 damage each second. End effect: that foe is healed for 36...120.

name: Images of Remorse
description: Hex Spell. For 5...10 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration. If that foe was attacking, that foe takes 10...52 damage.
concise: Hex Spell. (5...10 seconds.) Causes -1...3 Health degeneration. Initial effect: 10...52 damage if target foe is attacking.

name: Impale
description: Skill. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe is struck for 25...100 earth damage and suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Skill. Deals 25...100 earth damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). Must follow a dual attack.

name: Iron Palm
description: Skill. Target touched foe suffers 5...50 damage, and if that foe is suffering from a hex or condition that foe is knocked down. Iron Palm counts as a lead attack.
concise: Touch Skill. Deals 5...50 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is hexed or has a condition. Counts as a lead attack.

name: Jagged Strike
description: Lead Attack. If Jagged Strike hits, your target suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Lead Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Jaizhenju Strike
description: Sword Attack. If Jaizhenju Strike hits, you strike for +1...30 damage. If you are not using a stance, Jaizhenju Strike cannot be blocked.
concise: Sword Attack. Deals +1...30 damage. Unblockable unless you are in a stance.

name: Jamei's Gaze
description: Spell. Heal target other ally for 35...180 Health.
concise: Spell. Heals for 35...180. Cannot self-target.

name: Jaundiced Gaze
description: Enchantment Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, for the next 1...20 seconds, your next enchantment spell casts 0...1 seconds faster and costs 1...10 less Energy.
concise: Enchantment Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: your next enchantment casts 0...1 seconds faster and costs 1...10 less Energy. (1...20 seconds)

triggers: You or ally casts a spell

name: Jungle Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...25 damage. If it hits a foe that was Crippled, that foe and all adjacent foes take 1...31 damage.
concise: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10...25 damage. Deals 1...31 damage to target and adjacent foes if target foe is Crippled. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Karei's Healing Circle
description: Spell. Heal yourself and all adjacent creatures for 30...180 points.
concise: Spell. Heals you for 30...180. Also heals adjacent creatures.

name: Kirin's Wrath
description: Spell. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location in which the spell was cast take 8...32 holy damage each second.
concise: Spell. Deals 8...32 holy damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to your initial location.

name: Kitah's Burden
description: Hex Spell. For 6...12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Kitah's Burden ends you gain 10...18 Energy.
concise: Hex Spell. (6...12 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower. End effect: you gain 10...18 Energy.

name: Lacerate
description: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Bleeding creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit creatures within its range that have less than 90% Health begin Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
concise: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Bleeding creatures in range have -2 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5...25 seconds) on creatures in range that have less than 90% Health. Does not affect spirits.

name: Lacerating Chop
description: Axe Attack. If Lacerating Chop hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it strikes a knocked down foe your target suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Axe Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

name: Lamentation
description: Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0...3 Health degeneration. When this hex is applied, these foes take 10...50 damage if you are within earshot of a spirit or corpse.
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target (5...20 seconds). Causes -0...3 Health degeneration. Initial effect: deals 10...50 damage to these foes if you are within earshot of a spirit or corpse.

name: Lava Arrows
description: Spell. Lava Arrows fly toward up to 3 foes near your target and strike for 20...65 fire damage if they hit.
concise: Spell. Projectile: deals 20...65 fire damage. Bonus effect: sends projectiles at 2 other foes near your target.

name: Leaping Mantis Sting
description: Lead Attack. If Mantis Sting hits, target foe takes +5...15 damage. If this attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is Crippled for 3...15 seconds.
concise: Lead Attack. Deals +5...15 damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) if target foe is moving.

name: Leviathan's Sweep
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If this attack is blocked, your target is knocked down and suffers 10...34 damage.
concise: Melee Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down and deals 10...34 damage if blocked.

name: Life
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit allies within its range are healed for 1...7 Health for each second this spirit was alive. This spirit dies after 20 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (20 second lifespan). Affects non-spirit allies within range. End effect: heals for 1...7 for each second this spirit was alive.

name: Life Sheath
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Remove 0...2 conditions from target ally. For 8 seconds, the next time that ally would take damage or life steal, that ally gains that amount of Health instead (maximum 20...100).
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Converts the next incoming damage or life steal (maximum 20...100) to healing. Initial effect: Removes 0...2 conditions.

name: Lifebane Strike
description: Spell. Target foe takes 12...48 shadow damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you steal up to 12...48 Health.
concise: Spell. Deals 12...48 damage. Steals 12...48 Health if target foe's Health is above 50%.

name: Lightning Hammer
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...100 lightning damage and applies Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds. Lightning Hammer has 25% armor penetration.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...100 lightning damage. Applies Cracked Armor (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration.

name: Lively Was Naomei
description: Item Spell. Hold Naomei's ashes for up to 45 seconds. When you drop her ashes, all party members in the area are resurrected with 15...75% Health and zero Energy.
concise: Item Spell. (45 seconds.) Drop effect: resurrects party members in the area (15...75% Health and zero Energy).

name: Locust's Fury
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10...35 seconds, you have an additional 50% chance to double strike while using daggers.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10...35 seconds.) You have +50% chance to double strike. No effect unless you are wielding daggers.

name: Lyssa's Aura
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you have +0...5 Energy regeneration. This enchantment reapplies itself every time you cast a spell on a foe.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You have +0...5 Energy regeneration. Renewal: every time you cast a spell on an enemy.

triggers: You or ally casts a spell

name: Lyssa's Balance
description: Spell. Target foe loses one enchantment. If you have more enchantments than target foe, this skill has no effect.
concise: Spell. Removes one enchantment from target foe. No effect if you have more enchantments than this foe.

name: Mantis Touch
description: Skill. Target foe becomes Crippled for 5...20 seconds. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
concise: Skill. Inflicts Crippled condition (5...20 seconds). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.

name: Marauder's Shot
description: Bow Attack. If Marauder's Shot hits, you strike for +25...55 damage and all your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
concise: Bow Attack. Deals +25...55 damage. Your non-attack skills are disabled (5 seconds) if this attack hits.

name: Mark of Death
description: Hex Spell. For 4...10 seconds, target foe gains 50% less benefit from healing.
concise: Hex Spell. (4...10 seconds.) Target foe receives 50% less from healing.

name: Mark of Instability
description: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack skill that foe is knocked down.
concise: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) Causes knock-down the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack.

name: Melandru's Shot
description: Elite Bow Attack. If Melandru's Shot hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. If it hits a foe that is moving or knocked down, that foe takes +10...25 damage and is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
concise: Elite Bow Attack. Inflicts Bleeding (5...25 seconds). Deals +10...25 damage and inflicts Crippled (5...15 seconds) if target foe was moving or knocked down.

name: Mend Body and Soul
description: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20...115 Health. That ally loses one condition for each spirit within earshot.
concise: Spell. Heals for 20...115. Removes one condition for each spirit within earshot.

name: Mighty Was Vorizun
description: Item Spell. Hold Vorizun's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.
concise: Item Spell. (15...60 seconds.) You have +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.

name: Mirror of Ice
description: Elite Hex Spell. Shatter a Mirror of Ice. All foes near you and target ally take 15...70 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2...6 seconds. If you strike a foe hexed with Water Magic, Mirror of Ice recharges 50% faster.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. Deals 15...70 cold damage and slows foes by 66% (2...6 seconds). Hits foes near you and target ally. Recharges 50% faster if it hits a foe hexed with Water Magic.

name: Mirrored Stance
description: Hex Spell. For 10...35 seconds, whenever target foe enters a stance, you enter the same stance.
concise: Hex Spell. (10...35 seconds.) You enter any stance used by target foe.

name: Moebius Strike
description: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a Dual Attack. If it hits, Moebius Strike strikes for +10...35 damage. If you strike a foe whose Health is below 50%, all your other attack skills are recharged.
concise: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10...35 damage. Recharges all your other attack skills if target foe's Health is below 50%. Must follow a dual attack.

name: Needling Shot
description: Bow Attack. Needling Shot strikes for only 10...30 damage and moves faster than normal. If Needling Shot strikes a foe below 50% Health, Needling Shot recharges instantly. Your other attack skills are disabled for 2 seconds.
concise: Bow Attack. Fast-moving arrow. Deals 10...30 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is below 50% Health. Your other attack skills are disabled (2 seconds).

name: Nightmare Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 12 seconds, target ally has a Nightmare Weapon. Target ally's next 3 attacks are reduced by 10...50 damage and steal up to 10...50 Health.
concise: Weapon Spell. (12 seconds.) Target ally's attacks steal 10...50 Health but deal 10...50 less damage. Ends after 3 attacks.

name: Nine Tail Strike
description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. Nine Tail Strike cannot be blocked and strikes for +15...40 damage if it hits.
concise: Dual Attack. Deals +15...40 damage. Unblockable. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Oppressive Gaze
description: Spell. Target foe and adjacent foes take 10...30 shadow damage. Foes already suffering from a condition are Poisoned and Weakened for 3...12 seconds.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...30 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Poison and Weakness (3...12 seconds) on foes suffering from a condition.

name: Order of Apostasy
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that foe loses one enchantment. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 10...3% maximum Health.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). These party members remove one enchantment when they deal physical damage. Removal cost: for each Monk enchantment, you lose 10...3% maximum Health.

name: Overload
description: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, Overload deals 15...75 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.
concise: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -1...3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, that foe takes 15...75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.

name: Pain
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...12 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...30 damage. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...30 damage.

name: Painful Bond
description: Hex Spell. For 10...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Painful Bond and take 8...20 damage whenever hit by a spirit's attack.
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (10...20 seconds). Spirits do 8...20 more damage against these foes.

name: Palm Strike
description: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 10...65 damage and is Crippled for 1...5 seconds. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
concise: Elite Touch Skill. Deals 10...65 damage and inflicts Crippled condition (1...5 seconds). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.

name: Penetrating Chop
description: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10...25 damage. This axe attack has 20% armor penetration.
concise: Axe Attack. Deals +10...25 damage. 20% armor penetration.

name: Poisonous Bite
description: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Poisonous Bite that Poisons target foe for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Pet Attack. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Pounce
description: Pet Attack. Your animal companion's next attack is a Pounce that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.
concise: Pet Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

name: Power Leech
description: Elite Hex Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 10 seconds, whenever that foe casts a spell, you steal up to 5...15 Energy from that foe.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. Interrupt a spell or a chant. Interruption effect: steal 5...15 Energy whenever target foe casts a spell (10 seconds).

name: Power Return
description: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe gains 10...5 Energy.
concise: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: target foe gains 10...5 Energy.

name: Predatory Bond
description: Shout. For 5...20 seconds, your animal companion attacks 25% faster and heals you for 1...31 Health with each successful attack.
concise: Shout. (5...20 seconds.) Your pet attacks 25% faster and you gain 1...31 Health whenever your pet makes a successful attack.

name: Preservation
description: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...14 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10...115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
concise: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10...115.

name: Primal Rage
description: Elite Stance. For 1...9 seconds, you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 150...125% damage.
concise: Elite Stance. (1...9 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. You take 150...125% damage.

name: Protective Was Kaolai
description: Item Spell. Hold Kaolai's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain 20 armor. When you drop his ashes, all party members are healed for 20...95 Health.
concise: Item Spell. (15...60 seconds.) You have +20 armor. Drop effect: all party members are healed for 20...95.

name: Protector's Defense
description: Skill. For 5...11 seconds, allies adjacent to you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Protector's Defense ends if you move.
concise: Skill. (5...11 seconds.) Allies adjacent to you have 75% chance to block. Ends if you move.

name: Psychic Distraction
description: Elite Spell. All of your other skills are disabled for 8 seconds. If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5...12 seconds.
concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+5...12 seconds). Your other skills are disabled (8 seconds).

name: Psychic Instability
description: Elite Spell. Interrupts the target foe's action. If that action is a skill, that foe and all nearby foes are knocked down for 2...4 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, causes knockdown for 2...4 seconds on target foe and all nearby foes. 50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.

name: Quivering Blade
description: Elite Sword Attack. If Quivering Blade hits, you strike for +10...40 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, that foe is Dazed for 10 seconds.
concise: Elite Sword Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (10 seconds) if target foe was moving.

name: Ray of Judgment
description: Elite Spell. Invoke a Ray of Judgment at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 10...50 holy damage and begin Burning for 1...3 seconds every second.
concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...50 holy damage and inflicts Burning (1...3 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

name: Recall
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain Recall, nothing happens. When Recall ends, you Shadow Step to the ally you targeted when you activated this skill, and all of your skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. End effect: Shadow Step to target ally. Cannot self-target and disables all of your skills for 3 seconds when it ends.

name: Reckless Haste
description: Hex Spell. For 6...12 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes are hexed with Reckless Haste. While hexed, they attack 25% faster but have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (6...12 seconds). These foes have 50% chance to miss, but attack 25% faster.

name: Recuperation
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...14 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range gain +1...3 Health regeneration. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have +1...3 Health regeneration.

name: Recurring Insecurity
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers from -1...6 Health degeneration. If that foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end, it is reapplied.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -1...6 Health degeneration. Renewal: if target foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end.

name: Release Enchantments
description: Spell. Lose all enchantments. Each party member is healed for 5...35 Health for each Monk enchantment lost.
concise: Spell. Removes all of your enchantments. Heals all party members for 5...35 for each Monk enchantment removed.

name: Renewing Smash
description: Hammer Attack. If Renewing Smash hits, it deals +10...40 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe, you gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly.
concise: Hammer Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. You gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly if target foe was knocked down.

name: Repeating Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...30 damage. If it misses, it takes an additional 15 seconds to recharge.
concise: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10...30 damage. This skill has +15 second recharge time if it misses. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Resilient Was Xiko
description: Item Spell. Hold Xiko's ashes for up to 5...20 seconds. For each hex or condition you are suffering from while holding her ashes, you gain +3 Health regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you lose 1...4 conditions.
concise: Item Spell. (5...20 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each hex or condition on you. Drop effect: you lose 1...4 conditions.

name: Resilient Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 3...12 seconds, target ally has a Resilient Weapon. While suffering from a hex or condition, that ally gains +1...6 Health regeneration and +24 armor.
concise: Weapon Spell. (3...12 seconds.) +1...6 Health regeneration and +24 armor. No effect unless target ally is hexed or has a condition.

name: Restoration
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all party members in the area are resurrected with 5...50% Health and zero Energy. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30 second lifespan). End effect: resurrects party members in the area with 5...50% Health and zero Energy.

name: Resurrection Chant
description: Spell. Resurrect target party member with up to your current Health and 5...35% Energy. This spell has half the normal range.
concise: Half Range Spell. Resurrects target party member at your current Health and with 5...35% Energy.

name: Return
description: Spell. All adjacent foes are Crippled for 3...8 seconds. Shadow Step to target other ally's location.
concise: Spell. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...8 seconds) on all foes adjacent to you. You Shadow Step to target ally's location. Cannot self-target.

name: Revealed Enchantment
description: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe and gain 3...15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.
concise: Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effects: you gain 3...15 Energy; this spell is replaced with that enchantment (20 seconds).

name: Revealed Hex
description: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4...10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.
concise: Spell. Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effects: you gain 4...10 Energy; this spell is replaced with that hex (20 seconds).

name: Reverse Hex
description: Enchantment Spell. Remove one hex from target ally. If a hex was removed in this way, for 5...10 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, that damage is reduced by 5...50.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...10 seconds.) Removes one hex from target ally. The next damage this ally takes is reduced by 5...50. No effect unless this ally is hexed.

name: Ride the Lightning
description: Elite Spell. You Ride the Lightning to target. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 1...5 seconds. If your target is a foe, it is struck for 10...70 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...70 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Blinds all adjacent foes (1...5 seconds). You instantly move to your target. May target allies.

name: Rising Bile
description: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, this hex does nothing. When Rising Bile ends, that foe and all foes in the area take 1...6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect.
concise: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) End effect: deals 1...6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect. Also damages other foes in the area.

name: Ritual Lord
description: Elite Skill. For 5...35 seconds, your Ritualist attributes are boosted by 2...4 for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10...60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.
concise: Elite Skill. (5...35 seconds.) You have +2...4 to all Ritualist attributes for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10...60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.

name: Run as One
description: Stance. For 5...15 seconds, you and your pet run 25% faster.
concise: Stance. (5...15 seconds.) You and your pet move 25% faster.

name: Rupture Soul
description: Spell. Target allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby enemies are struck for 50...140 lightning damage and become blinded for 3...12 seconds.
concise: Spell. Destroys target allied spirit. Deals 50...140 lightning damage and inflicts Blindness condition (3...12 seconds) to nearby foes.

name: Savage Pounce
description: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Savage Pounce that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.
concise: Pet Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is casting a spell.

name: Scorpion Wire
description: Hex Spell. For 8...20 seconds, the next time you and target foe are more than 75' apart, you Shadow Step to that foe and that foe is knocked down. This spell has half the normal range.
concise: Half Range Hex Spell. (8...20 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe and cause knock-down the next time this foe is more than 75' away from you.

name: Second Wind
description: Elite Spell. You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Energy restricted by Overcast. You lose all enchantments.
concise: Elite Spell. You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Overcast. You lose all enchantments.

name: Seeking Arrows
description: Preparation. For 3...14 seconds, your arrows cannot be blocked. Seeking Arrows ends if you fail to hit.
concise: Preparation. (3...14 seconds.) Your arrows are unblockable. Ends if you fail to hit.

name: Seeping Wound
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (1...7 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.

name: Selfless Spirit
description: Enchantment Spell. For 15...20 seconds, spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less Energy.

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (15...20 seconds.) Spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less Energy.

name: Shadow Form
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...21 seconds, you cannot be the target of enemy spells, and you gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than 5...25 damage with a single skill or attack.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5...21 seconds.) Enemy spells cannot target you. Gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than 5...25 damage with a single skill or attack.

name: Shadow Refuge
description: Enchantment Spell. For 6 seconds, you gain 5...10 Health regeneration. When Shadow Refuge ends, you gain 40...100 Health if you are attacking.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (6 seconds.) You have +5...10 Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for 40...100 if you are attacking.

name: Shadow Sanctuary
description: Enchantment Spell. You are Blinded for 5 seconds. For 10 seconds, you gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor.

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor. You are Blind (5 seconds).

name: Shadow Shroud
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 3...9 seconds, target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (3...9 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.

name: Shadow of Haste
description: Stance. For 10...40 seconds you move 15% faster than normal. When Shadow of Haste ends, you Shadow Step to your original location.
concise: Stance. (10...40 seconds.) You move 15% faster. End effect: return to your original location.

name: Shadowsong
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and cause Blindness for 1...6 seconds. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30-second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and inflict Blindness condition (1...6 seconds).

name: Shadowy Burden
description: Hex Spell. For 3...15 seconds, target foe moves 25% slower and while target foe has no other hexes, that foe has 20...30 less armor against your attacks.
concise: Hex Spell. (3...15 seconds.) Target foe moves 25% slower and has 20...30 less armor against your attacks. Armor reduction only affects this foe while it has no other hexes.

name: Shameful Fear
description: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe moves 10% faster than normal. For each second, if that foe is moving, that foe takes 5...20 damage.
concise: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Target foe takes 5...20 damage each second while moving, but moves 10% faster.

name: Shared Burden
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack, cast spells, and move 50% slower.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5...20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 50% slower.

name: Sharpen Daggers
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...30 seconds, your dagger attacks cause Bleeding for 5...15 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...30 seconds.) Your dagger attacks inflict the Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds).

name: Shatter Storm
description: Elite Spell. Target foe loses all enchantments. For each enchantment removed this way, Shatter Storm is disabled for an additional 7 seconds.
concise: Elite Spell. Removes all enchantments. Removal cost: Shatter Storm is disabled for +7 seconds for each enchantment removed.

name: Shatterstone
description: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 25...100 cold damage, moves 66% slower, and is hexed with Shatterstone for 3 seconds. When Shatterstone ends, that foe and all nearby foes are struck for 25...100 cold damage.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (3 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 25...100 cold damage and target moves 66% slower. End effect: deals 25...100 cold damage to target and all nearby foes.

name: Shelter
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...12 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. When this spirit prevents damage, it loses 75...45 Health. This spirit lasts 30...60 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses 75...45 Health.

name: Shield Guardian
description: Enchantment Spell. For 2...6 seconds, all party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. If an attack is blocked, all allies in earshot are healed for 10...40 Health and Shield Guardian ends.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (2...6 seconds). Party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. Block effect: Allies in earshot are healed for 10...40 and Shield Guardian ends.

name: Shivers of Dread
description: Hex Spell. For 10...40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted and you lose 8...3 Energy or Shivers of Dread ends.
concise: Hex Spell. (10...40 seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. Interruption cost: you lose 8...3 Energy or this hex ends.

name: Shock Arrow
description: Spell. Send out a Shock Arrow that flies swiftly toward target foe, striking for 5...50 lightning damage. If Shock Arrow strikes a foe suffering from Cracked Armor, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage. Shock Arrow has 25% armor penetration.
concise: Spell. Rapid projectile: deals 5...50 lightning damage. Gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if you hit a foe suffering from Cracked Armor. 25% armor penetration.

name: Shockwave
description: Elite Spell. All foes in the area take 15...60 earth damage and are Weakened for 1...10 seconds. Nearby foes also take +15...60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor for 1...10 seconds. Adjacent foes suffer the previous effects, take +15...60 earth damage, and are Blinded for 1...10 seconds.
concise: Elite Spell. Foes in the area take 15...60 earth damage and are Weakened (1...10 seconds). Nearby foes also take +15...60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor (1...10 seconds). Adjacent foes also take +15...60 earth damage and are Blinded (1...10 seconds).

name: Shove
description: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 15...75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.
concise: Elite Touch Skill. Target touched foe takes 15...75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.

name: Shroud of Distress
description: Enchantment Spell. For 30...60 seconds, if you are below 50% Health, you have +3...8 Health regeneration and a 75% chance to block attacks.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (30...60 seconds.) You have +3...8 Health regeneration and 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.

name: Shroud of Silence
description: Elite Hex Spell. All of your spells are disabled for 15 seconds. For 1...6 seconds, target touched foe cannot cast spells.
concise: Elite Touch Hex Spell. (1...6 seconds.) Target foe cannot cast spells. Your spells are disabled for 15 seconds.

name: Signet of Corruption
description: Signet. Target foe and all nearby foes take 20...30 damage. For each affected foe suffering from a condition or hex, you gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20 Energy).

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Signet. Deals 20...30 damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20) for each of these foes with a condition or hex.

name: Signet of Creation
description: Signet. You gain 4 Energy for every summoned creature you control within earshot (maximum 3...12 Energy).
concise: Signet. Gain 4 Energy (maximum 3...12) for each summoned creature you control within earshot.

name: Signet of Disenchantment
description: Signet. Lose all Energy. Target foe loses one enchantment.
concise: Signet. Removes one enchantment. You lose all Energy.

name: Signet of Disruption
description: Signet. If target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and that foe suffers 10...51 damage. If that foe is hexed, Signet of Disruption can interrupt any non-spell skills.
concise: Signet. Interrupts a spell. Can interrupt any skill if target foe is hexed. Interruption effect: deals 10...51 damage.

name: Signet of Malice
description: Signet. For each condition suffered by target foe, you lose one condition.
concise: Signet. You lose one condition for each condition on target foe.

name: Signet of Rage
description: Signet. Target foe takes 5...50 holy damage and +5...10 holy damage for each adrenaline skill that foe has.
concise: Signet. Deals 5...50 holy damage. Deals 5...10 more holy damage for each of target foe's adrenaline skills.

name: Signet of Rejuvenation
description: Signet. Heal target ally for 15...75. If target ally is casting a spell or attacking, that ally is healed for an additional 15...75 Health.
concise: Signet. Heals for 15...75. Heals for 15...75 more if target ally is casting a spell or attacking.

name: Signet of Shadows
description: Signet. Target foe takes 5...35 damage. If your target was Blinded, that foe suffers an additional 15...60 damage.
concise: Signet. Deals 5...35 damage. Deals 15...60 more damage if target foe is Blinded.

name: Signet of Spirits
description: Elite Signet. Create 3 level 1...12 spirits. These spirits deal 5...20 damage with attacks and die after 60 seconds.
concise: Elite Signet. Creates 3 level 1...12 spirits (60 second lifespan). These spirits deal 5...20 damage with attacks.

name: Signet of Strength
description: Signet. Your next 1...16 attacks deal +5 damage.
concise: Signet. Your attacks deal +5 damage. Ends after 1...16 attacks.

name: Silverwing Slash
description: Sword Attack. This attack strikes for +1...40 damage if it hits.
concise: Sword Attack. Deals +1...40 damage.

name: Siphon Speed
description: Hex Spell. For 5...15 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. This spell recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.
concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. Recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.

name: Siphon Strength
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe deals -5...50 damage with attacks and all of your attacks against that foe have an additional 50% chance of being a critical hit.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Target foe deals -5...50 attack damage. You have +50% chance to land a critical hit on this foe.

name: Sliver Armor
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...11 seconds, you have 25...50% chance to block attacks and whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack one nearby foe is struck for 5...35 earth damage.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...11 seconds.) You have 25...50% chance to block. Deals 5...35 earth damage to one nearby foe whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack.

name: Smoldering Embers
description: Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...70 fire damage. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Smoldering Embers for 3 seconds and takes 5...25 additional fire damage each second.
concise: Hex Spell. Deals 10...70 fire damage to target. If you are Overcast, foe is hexed for 3 seconds, taking 5...25 fire damage each second.

name: Snare
description: Trap. When Snare is triggered, all nearby foes become Crippled for 3...15 seconds. Snare ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
concise: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds). Easily interrupted.

name: Soothing
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...12 spirit. All foes within its range take twice as long to build adrenaline. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...12 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Building adrenaline takes twice as long for foes within range.

name: Soothing Memories
description: Spell. Target ally is healed for 10...100 Health. If you are holding an item, you gain 3 Energy.
concise: Spell. Heals for 10...100. You gain 3 Energy if you are holding an item.

name: Soul Bind
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20...80 damage. This hex ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20...80 damage. Ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.

name: Soul Twisting
description: Elite Skill. For 5...45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. Soul Twisting ends after 1...3 Binding Rituals.
concise: Elite Skill. (5...45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. Ends after 1...3 Binding Rituals.

name: Spear of Fury
description: Spear Attack. This attack deals +30...40 damage. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline.

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Spear Attack. Deals +30...40 damage. Gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline if you hit a foe with a condition.

name: Spear of Light
description: Spell. Spear of Light flies toward target foe and deals 26...56 holy damage if it hits. Spear of Light deals +15...60 damage if it hits an attacking foe.
concise: Spell. Projectile: deals 26...56 holy damage. Deals 15...60 more damage if target foe is attacking.

name: Spell Shield
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, while you are casting spells, foes cannot target you with spells. When Spell Shield ends, all your skills are disabled for 8...4 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) While casting spells, you cannot be the target of spells. End effect: your skills are disabled (8...4 seconds).

name: Spirit Bond
description: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30...90 Health.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Heals for 30...90 whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage. Ends after this ally takes damage from 10 attacks or spells.

name: Spirit Boon Strike
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20...65 lightning damage, and all spirits you control within earshot gain 20...65 Health.
concise: Spell. Deals 20...65 lightning damage. Spirits you control within earshot gain 20...65 Health.

name: Spirit Burn
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5...50 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, Spirit Burn causes Burning for 1...5 seconds.
concise: Spell. Deals 5...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...5 seconds) if you are within earshot of a spirit.

name: Spirit Channeling
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 12 seconds, you have +1...6 Energy regeneration. When you cast this spell, you gain 3...12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (12 seconds.) You have +1...6 Energy regeneration. Initial effect: you gain 3...12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.

name: Spirit Light
description: Spell. Target ally is healed for 60...180. If any spirits are within earshot, you don't sacrifice Health.
concise: Spell. Heals for 60...180. You don't sacrifice Health if you are within earshot of any spirits.

name: Spirit Light Weapon
description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains 5...25 Health per second and an additional 5...25 Health per second if that ally is within earshot of a spirit.
concise: Elite Weapon Spell. (10 seconds.) Target ally gains 5...25 Health each second. 5...25 more healing per second while within earshot of a spirit.

name: Spirit Rift
description: Spell. Open a Spirit Rift at target foe's location. After 3 seconds, all adjacent foes are struck for 25...125 lightning damage and suffer from Cracked Armor for 1...20 seconds.
concise: Spell. After 3 seconds, affects foes adjacent to target's initial location. Deals 25...125 lightning damage and inflicts Cracked Armor (1...20 seconds).

name: Spirit Siphon
description: Spell. The spirit closest to you loses all Energy. You gain 30...60% of that Energy.
concise: Spell. The spirit closest to you loses all Energy. You gain 30...60% of that Energy.

name: Spirit Transfer
description: Spell. The spirit nearest you loses 5...50 Health. Target ally is healed for 5 for each point of Health lost.
concise: Spell. The spirit nearest you loses 5...50 Health. Heals target ally for 5 for each point of Health lost.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Spell. Shadow Step to target spirit.
concise: Spell. Shadow Step to target Spirit.

name: Spirit to Flesh
description: Spell. Target touched allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby allies are healed for 30...240.
concise: Touch Spell. Destroys target touched allied spirit. Heals nearby allies for 30...240.

name: Splinter Shot
description: Bow Attack. If Splinter Shot hits, you deal +3...15 damage. If Splinter Shot is blocked, all foes in the area of your target take 5...65 damage.
concise: Bow Attack. Deals +3...15 damage. Deals 5...65 damage to foes in the area if blocked.

name: Splinter Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1...5 attacks deal 5...50 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
concise: Weapon Spell. (20 seconds.) Attacks deal 5...50 damage to 3 adjacent foes. Ends after 1...5 attacks.

name: Spoil Victor
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 3...15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health that foe loses 25...100 Health.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. (3...15 seconds.) Causes 25...100 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.

name: Standing Slash
description: Sword Attack. If it hits, Standing Slash deals +5...20 damage plus an additional 5...20 damage if you are in a stance.
concise: Sword Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...20 more damage if you are in a stance.

name: Star Burst
description: Elite Spell. Target touched foe and all foes in the area are struck for 7...112 fire damage and set on fire for 1...4 seconds. For each foe you hit, gain 2 Energy.
concise: Elite Touch Spell. Deals 7...112 fire damage. Inflicts Burning (1...4 seconds). Gain 2 Energy for each foe struck. Also hits foes in the area.

name: Star Servant
description: Skill. Summon a level-25 celestial horror at your location. Each time the celestial horror successfully lands an attack, your party gains 25 Health and 3 Energy.
concise: Skill. Summon a level 25 celestial horror. Your party members gain 25 Health and 3 Energy each time the celestial horror lands an attack.

name: Star Shine
description: Skill. Your entire party is healed to their maximum Health. All conditions and hexes are removed from your party.
concise: Skill. Heals your entire party to their maximum Health and removes all conditions and hexes.

name: Star Strike
description: Skill. For 10 seconds, upon every successful hit by you or a party member a level 20 celestial attacker is called forth to attack foes (maximum of 6).
concise: Skill. (10 seconds.) Party-wide effect. Every successful attack summons a level 20 celestial attacker (maximum of 6).

name: Stolen Speed
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 1...10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells targeting these foes that are cast by you or your allies take 50% less time to cast.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes adjacent foes (1...10 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. Spells cast by you or your allies on hexed foes have -50% casting time.

name: Stonesoul Strike
description: Skill. Touched target foe takes 10...55 holy damage. If knocked down, your target takes an additional 10...55 holy damage.
concise: Touch Skill. Deals 10...55 holy damage. Deals 10...55 more holy damage if target foe is knocked-down.

name: Storm of Swords
description: Skill. For 15 seconds, you and all adjacent allies deal 25 damage to all adjacent foes each second.
concise: Skill. (15 seconds.) Affects you and all adjacent allies. Deals 25 damage to all adjacent foes each second.

name: Summon Spirits
description: Spell. All spirits you control Shadow Step to your location, and gain 60...100 Health

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Spell. Spirits you control Shadow Step to your location and gain 60...100 Health.

name: Sun and Moon Slash
description: Sword Attack. Attack target foe twice. These attacks cannot be blocked.
concise: Sword Attack. You attack target foe twice. Unblockable.

name: Sundering Attack
description: Bow Attack. If Sundering Attack hits, you strike for +5...25 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
concise: Bow Attack. Deals +5...25 damage. 10% armor penetration.

name: Taste of Pain
description: Spell. If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 30...150 Health.
concise: Spell. Heals you for 30...150. No effect unless target foe is below 50% Health.

name: Teinai's Crystals
description: Spell. Target foe takes 20...40 damage. If target foe has a Water Magic hex, this spell strikes target and nearby foes for an additional 20...40 damage, and nearby foes also suffer Cracked Armor for 5...15 seconds.
concise: Spell. Deals 20...40 damage to target. Deals +20...40 more damage and causes Cracked Armor (5...15 seconds) nearby if that foe had a Water Magic hex.

name: Teinai's Heat
description: Ward Spell. Place a ward of Teinai's Heat at your location for 10...15 seconds. Foes within the ward suffer 2...5 health degeneration. Weakened foes attack 33% slower. This skill is disabled for 20 seconds.
concise: Ward Spell. (10...15 seconds.) Causes -2...5 health degeneration. Weakened foes in the ward attack 33% slower. Disabled for 20 seconds.

name: Teinai's Prison
description: Hex Spell. For 1...8 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower. If that foe has Cracked Armor, the chill seeps through causing 5...9 Health degeneration.
concise: Hex Spell. (1...8 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower. Foes with Cracked Armor have 5...9 Health degeneration.

name: Teinai's Wind
description: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 10...40 cold damage. Burning foes struck by Teinai's Wind take an additional 40...80 damage and are interrupted.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...40 cold damage. Burning foes take +40...80 damage and are interrupted. Also strikes adjacent.

name: Temple Strike
description: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Dazed and Blinded for 1...10 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell, that foe is interrupted.
concise: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed and Blindness conditions (1...10 seconds). Must follow a lead attack.

name: Tiger Stance
description: Stance. For 4...10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. Tiger Stance ends if any of your attacks fail to hit.
concise: Stance. (4...10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. Ends if you fail to hit.

name: Tranquil Was Tanasen
description: Elite Item Spell. Hold Tanasen's ashes for up to 5...20 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you have +10...25 armor and cannot be interrupted.
concise: Elite Item Spell. (5...20 seconds.) You have +10...25 armor. You cannot be interrupted.

name: Tranquility
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 15...120 seconds.
concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 20...50% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

name: Trapper's Focus
description: Elite Preparation. For 12...36 seconds, your trap skills are not easily interruptible and your Wilderness Survival attribute is increased by 0...4.
concise: Elite Preparation. (12...36 seconds.) Your trap skills are no longer easy to interrupt. You gain +0...4 to your Wilderness Survival attribute.

name: Triple Chop
description: Elite Axe Attack. Attack target foe and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +10...40 damage.
concise: Elite Axe Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. Also hits adjacent foes.

name: Triple Shot
description: Bow Attack. Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40...25% less damage.

acquisition.titleRequirement: After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

concise: Bow Attack. Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40...25% less damage.

name: Twisting Fangs
description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Twisting Fangs strikes for +10...20 damage and struck foe suffers from Bleeding and Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Dual Attack. Deals +10...20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding and Deep Wound conditions (5...20 seconds). Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Union
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...12 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit ally in its range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Whenever a non-spirit ally within range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage.

name: Unnatural Signet
description: Signet. Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, foes adjacent to your target take 5...50 damage.
concise: Signet. Deals 15...75 damage. Deals 5...50 damage to other adjacent foes if the target is hexed or enchanted.

name: Unseen Fury
description: Stance. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 3...10 seconds. For 10...30 seconds, you cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
concise: Stance. Inflicts Blindness condition on adjacent foes (3...10 seconds). You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes (10...30 seconds).

name: Unsteady Ground
description: Elite Spell. You create Unsteady Ground at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, nearby foes take 10...40 earth damage each second. Attacking foes struck by Unsteady Ground are knocked down.
concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...40 earth damage each second (5 seconds) and causes knock-down to attacking foes. Hits foes near target's initial location.

name: Unsuspecting Strike
description: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +19...31 damage. If your target was above 90% Health you deal an additional 15...75 damage.
concise: Lead Attack. Deals +19...31 damage. Deals 15...75 more damage if target foe's Health is above 90%.

name: Vampiric Bite
description: Skill. Touch target foe to steal up to 29...74 Health.
concise: Touch Skill. Steals 29...74 Health.

name: Vampiric Spirit
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal up to 15...60 Health from target foe. For 10 seconds, you have +5...10 Health regeneration.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal 15...60 Health from target foe. You have +5...10 Health regeneration (10 seconds).

name: Vampiric Swarm
description: Spell. Vampiric Swarm steals up to 15...60 Health from up to three foes in the area.
concise: Spell. Steals 15...60 Health. Hits 2 additional foes in the area.

name: Vapor Blade
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15...135 cold damage. Vapor Blade deals half damage if that foe has any enchantments on them.
concise: Spell. Deals 15...135 cold damage. Half damage if target foe is enchanted.

name: Vengeful Was Khanhei
description: Elite Item Spell. Hold Khanhei's ashes for 5...11 seconds. Whenever a foe strikes you in combat while you are holding Khanhei's ashes, you steal 10...45 Health from that foe.
concise: Elite Item Spell. (5...11 seconds.) You steal 10...45 Health from every foe that hits you with an attack.

name: Vengeful Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 15...60 Health from that foe.
concise: Weapon Spell. (8 seconds.) Steals 15...60 Health from the next foe that deals damage or life steal to target ally.

name: Vile Miasma
description: Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...65 cold damage. If suffering from a condition, that foe is hexed with Vile Miasma and suffers -1...5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
concise: Hex Spell. Causes -1...5 Health degeneration (10 seconds). Initial effect: deals 10...65 cold damage. Hex is only applied if target foe has a condition.

name: Viper's Defense
description: Spell. All adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5...20 seconds. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
concise: Spell. Inflict Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds) on all adjacent foes and Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

name: Viper's Nest
description: Trap. Create a Viper's Nest. When it is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...35 piercing damage and become Poisoned for 5...20 seconds. Viper's Nest expires after 90 seconds. This Trap is easily interrupted.
concise: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5...35 piercing damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). Easily interrupted.

name: Vital Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 5...30 seconds, target ally has a Vital Weapon and has +40...175 maximum Health.
concise: Weapon Spell. (5...30 seconds.) +40...175 maximum Health.

name: Wail of Doom
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 2...6 seconds, all of target foe's attributes are set to 0.
