concise: Signet. You lose 200...50 Health. Gain control of target enemy-controlled spirit. 50% failure chance unless Spawning Power 5 or more.

name: Signet of Clumsiness
description: Signet. If target foe is attacking, that foe and all adjacent foes are interrupted and take 15...60 damage. Any foes using attack skills are knocked down.
concise: Signet. Interrupts an attack for target foe and all adjacent foes. Interruption effect: deals 15...60 damage; knocks down foes using attack skills.

name: Signet of Ghostly Might
description: Elite Signet. For 5...20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal +5...10 damage.
concise: Elite Signet. (5...20 seconds.) All spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal +5...10 damage.

name: Signet of Illusions
description: Elite Signet. Your next 1...3 non-Illusion spells use your Illusion attribute instead of their normal attribute.
concise: Elite Signet. Your next 1...3 non-Illusion spells use your Illusion attribute instead of their normal attribute.

name: Signet of Lost Souls
description: Signet. If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy.
concise: Signet. You gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy if target foe is below 50% Health.

name: Signet of Mystic Wrath
description: Signet. Target foe takes 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).
concise: Signet. Deals 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).

name: Signet of Pious Light
description: Signet. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target ally is healed for 30...150 Health. If an enchantment was removed in this way, this signet recharges 75% faster.
concise: Signet. Heals for 30...150 Health. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 75% faster.

name: Signet of Removal
description: Elite Signet. If target ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally loses one hex and one condition.
concise: Elite Signet. Removes one hex and one condition. No effect unless target ally is enchanted.

name: Signet of Return
description: Signet. Resurrect target party member with 5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member within earshot.
concise: Signet. Resurrects target party member (5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member in earshot).

name: Signet of Sorrow
description: Signet. Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet, this skill recharges instantly.
concise: Signet. Deals 15...75 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet.

name: Signet of Stamina
description: Signet. You have +50...300 maximum Health. This signet ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
concise: Signet. You have +50...300 maximum Health. Ends if you hit with an attack.

name: Signet of Suffering
description: Elite Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 6 seconds. The next Necromancer skill that targets a foe causes Bleeding for 2...16 seconds.
concise: Elite Signet. You Bleed for 6 seconds. Applies Bleeding (2...16 seconds) to the target of your next Necromancer skill.

name: Signet of Synergy
description: Signet. Target other ally is healed for 40...100 Health. If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, you are also healed for 40...100 Health.
concise: Signet. Heal target ally for 40...100. You are also healed for 40...100 if you are not enchanted. Cannot self-target.

name: Signet of Toxic Shock
description: Signet. If target foe is suffering from Poison, that foe takes 10...100 damage.
concise: Signet. Deals 10...100 damage. No effect unless target foe is Poisoned.

name: Signet of Twilight
description: Signet. For each hex on target foe, that foe loses one enchantment.
concise: Signet. Removes one enchantment for each hex on target foe.

name: Simple Thievery
description: Elite Spell. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for 5...20 seconds, and Simple Thievery is replaced by that skill.
concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: If a skill was interrupted, that skill is disabled and Simple Thievery becomes that skill (5...20 seconds).

name: Slayer's Spear
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...25 damage. If that foe has more Health than you, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...25 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target has more Health than you.

name: Smoke Trap
description: Elite Trap. When Smoke Trap is triggered, foes in the area are Blinded and Dazed for 5...10 seconds. Smoke Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
concise: Elite Trap. (90 seconds.) Inflicts Blinded and Dazed conditions (5...10 seconds) to foes in the area. Easily interrupted.

name: Soldier's Defense
description: Stance. For 1...6 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block attacks while under the effects of a shout or chant. You gain 1 strike of adrenaline for each blocked attack.
concise: Stance. (1...6 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block while under the effects of a shout or chant. Block effect: gain 1 adrenaline.

name: Soldier's Fury
description: Elite Echo. For 10...35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
concise: Elite Echo. (10...35 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline if under the effects of a shout or chant. You have -20 armor

name: Soldier's Stance
description: Elite Stance. For 5...15 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
concise: Elite Stance. (5...15 seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.

name: Soldier's Strike
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 more damage. If you are under the effects of a chant or shout, this attack cannot be blocked.
concise: Melee Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable if you are under the effects of a chant or shout.

name: Song of Concentration
description: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next skill used by each ally within earshot cannot be interrupted.
concise: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are uninterruptible with their next skill.

name: Song of Power
description: Chant. For 5...20 seconds, each ally within earshot gains 4 Energy regeneration until that ally uses a skill.
concise: Chant. (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain +4 Energy regeneration. Ends when using a skill.

name: Song of Purification
description: Elite Chant. For 20 seconds, the next 1...6 skills used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
concise: Elite Chant. (20 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one condition with their next 1...6 skills.

name: Song of Restoration
description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45...110 Health.
concise: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45...110 Health with their next skill.

triggers: You or ally uses a skill

name: Spear of Lightning
description: Spear Attack. Strikes all foes between you and your target. If this attack hits, it deals +10...20 lightning damage. This attack has 25% armor penetration.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +10...20 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Strikes all foes between you and your target.

name: Spirit's Gift
description: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, all allies near that creature gain 5...50 Health and lose 1 condition.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Whenever you create a creature, all nearby allies gain 5...50 Health and lose one condition.

name: Spirit's Strength
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15...60 seconds, your attacks deal 5...35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (15...60 seconds.) Your attacks deal +5...35 damage if you are under a weapon spell.

name: Spiritual Pain
description: Spell. Target foe takes 15...75 damage. All hostile summoned creatures in the area of that foe take 25...125 damage.
concise: Spell. Deals 15...75 damage. Deals 25...125 damage to hostile summoned creatures in the area of target foe.

name: Staggering Force
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1...10 seconds.
concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor (1...10 seconds) on nearby foes.

name: Steady Stance
description: Elite Stance. For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1...4 strikes of adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.
concise: Elite Stance. (10 seconds.) The next time you would be knocked-down, you gain 1...4 adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.

name: Steam
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20...60 cold damage. If target foe is on fire, Steam Blinds that foe for 5...10 seconds and they take an additional 20...60 fire damage.
concise: Spell. Deals 20...60 cold damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (5...10 seconds) and does 20...60 fire damage if target foe is Burning.

name: Steelfang Slash
description: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +1...31 damage. If you hit a foe that is knocked down, you gain 1...5 adrenaline.
concise: Sword Attack. Deals +1...31 damage. You gain 1...5 adrenaline if target foe is knocked-down.

name: Stone Sheath
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, you and target ally have +1...30 armor and are immune to critical hits. When you cast this spell, all foes near you and your target take 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Gives you and target ally +1...30 armor and immunity to critical hits. Initial effect: Foes near you and target ally are struck for 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened (5...20 seconds).

name: Stone Striker
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...30 seconds, whenever you take or deal elemental or physical damage, that damage is converted to earth damage.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...30 seconds.) Converts elemental and physical damage you take or deal to earth damage.

name: Stoneflesh Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...15 seconds, damage you receive is reduced by 1...31, and you are immune to critical attacks.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Reduces damage you take by 1...31, and you are immune to critical hits.

name: Storm Djinn's Haste
description: Enchantment Spell. For 10...25 seconds, you move 25% faster. Each second that you are moving, you lose 1 Energy.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (10...25 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Lose 1 Energy each second while moving.

name: Storm's Embrace
description: Stance. For 10 seconds, you move 25% faster. This stance is refreshed whenever you take Elemental damage.
concise: Stance. (10 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Renewal: whenever you take elemental damage.

name: Strike as One
description: Elite Shout. Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5...15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
concise: Elite Shout. Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and inflicts Bleeding (5...15 seconds) with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, you inflict Crippled condition (5...15 seconds).

name: Stunning Strike
description: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4...10 seconds.
concise: Elite Spear Attack. Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds) if target has a condition.

name: Supportive Spirit
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...23 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage while knocked down, that ally is healed for 5...50 Health.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...23 seconds.) Heals for 5...50 whenever target ally takes damage while knocked-down.

name: Swap
description: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's location.
concise: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's locations.

name: Swift Javelin
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you are under the effects of an enchantment, this spear flies twice as fast and cannot be blocked.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. This spear moves twice as fast and is unblockable if you are enchanted.

name: Symbolic Celerity
description: Enchantment Spell. For 36...60 seconds, all of your signets use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (36...60 seconds.) Your signets use your Fast Casting attribute.

name: Symbolic Posture
description: Stance. For 5...20 seconds, the next signet you activate recharges 20...80% faster.
concise: Stance. (5...20 seconds.) Your next signet recharges 20...80% faster.

name: Symbols of Inspiration
description: Elite Skill. For 6...40 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
concise: Elite Skill. (6...40 seconds.) This skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.

name: Tease
description: Elite Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and other foes in the area are interrupted and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.
concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: also interrupts other foes in the area, and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.

name: Test of Faith
description: Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage and takes 1 enchantment from target foe. If that foe was not enchanted, that foe is Dazed for 2...6 seconds.
concise: Touch Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage and removes 1 enchantment. Target foe is Dazed for 2...6 seconds if that foe was not enchanted.

name: Toxic Chill
description: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, that foe becomes Poisoned for 10...25 seconds.
concise: Elite Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (10...25 seconds) if target foe is hexed or enchanted.

name: Toxicity
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Poisoned or Diseased creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Poisoned or Diseased creatures in range have -2 Health degeneration.

name: Trapper's Speed
description: Stance. For 5...30 seconds, your Traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. This stance ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
concise: Stance. (5...30 seconds.) Your traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. Ends if you hit with an attack.

name: Tripwire
description: Trap. When Tripwire is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...20 piercing damage. Any Crippled foes are knocked down. Tripwire ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
concise: Trap. (90 seconds.) Deals 5...20 piercing damage to nearby foes. Causes knock-down to Crippled foes. Easily interrupted.

name: Twin Moon Sweep
description: Melee Attack. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10...50 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, and you gain an additional 10...70 Health.
concise: Melee Attack. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10...50 Health. Removal effect: unblockable, attack twice, and gain 10...70 more Health.

name: Ulcerous Lungs
description: Hex Spell. For 10...30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer from -4 Health degeneration when Bleeding, and whenever they use a shout or chant, they Bleed for 5...20 seconds
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (10...30 seconds). Causes -4 Health degeneration to any of these foes that are Bleeding. Inflicts Bleeding (5...20 seconds) whenever these foes use a shout or chant.

name: Unblockable Throw
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. This attack cannot be blocked.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable.

name: Vampirism
description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 4...14 spirit that dies after 75...150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10...20 Health, and you are healed for 10...20 Health.
concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 4...14 spirit (lifespan 75...150 seconds). Its attacks steal 10...20 Health, and you are healed for 10...20.

name: Veil of Thorns
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 5...50 piercing damage. For 5...25 seconds, you take 5...35% less damage from spells.
concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (5...25 seconds.) Spell damage is reduced by 5...35%. Initial effect: nearby foes are struck for 5...50 piercing damage.

name: Vicious Attack
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you land a critical hit with this attack, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...15 seconds.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...15 seconds) with a critical hit.

name: Victorious Sweep
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...25 damage. If target foe has less Health than you, you gain 30...80 Health.
concise: Melee Attack. Deals +5...25 damage. You gain 30...80 Health for each foe you hit that has less Health than you.

name: Visions of Regret
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 15...45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 15...45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.

name: Vital Boon
description: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +40...100 maximum Health. When this enchantment ends, you are healed for 75...200 Health.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You have +40...100 maximum Health. End effect: heals you for 75...200.

name: Vocal Minority
description: Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes cannot use shouts or chants.
concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target (5...20 seconds). These foes cannot use shouts or chants.

name: Vocal Was Sogolon
description: Item Spell. For 60 seconds, all shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.
concise: Item Spell. (60 seconds.) Shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.

name: Vow of Piety
description: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Vow of Piety renews whenever an enchantment on you ends.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Renewal: whenever an enchantment on you ends.

name: Vow of Silence
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5...10 seconds.) Spells cannot target you. You cannot cast spells.

name: Vow of Strength
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10...25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (15 seconds.) Attacks with a scythe deal 10...25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes whenever you attack.

name: Warmonger's Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 3...13 seconds, if target ally attacks a foe who is not attacking, that foe is interrupted.
concise: Weapon Spell. (3...13 seconds.) Attacks interrupt an action. Does not interrupt attacking foes.

name: Wastrel's Collapse
description: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
concise: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. Causes knock-down if target foe is not using a skill. Disables your non-dagger attack skills (10 seconds).

name: Wastrel's Demise
description: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe is hexed with Wastrel's Demise. Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1...10 damage and an additional 1...10 damage for each second this spell is in effect. This hex ends prematurely if target foe uses a skill.
concise: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1...10 damage. Foes take +1...10 damage each second this hex is in effect. Ends early if target foe uses a skill.

name: Watchful Healing
description: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains +1...4 Health regeneration. If this skill ends prematurely, that ally gains 30...120 Health.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Target ally has +1...4 Health regeneration and gains 30...120 Health if this enchantment ends early.

name: Watchful Intervention
description: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%, that ally is healed for 50...200 Health.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Heals for 50...200 the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%.

name: Way of the Assassin
description: Elite Stance. For the next 20 seconds while wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have a +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.
concise: Elite Stance. (20 seconds.) While wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.

name: Weapon of Fury
description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
concise: Elite Weapon Spell. (5...20 seconds.) 100% more adrenaline gain and +1 Energy whenever target ally hits with an attack.

name: Weapon of Remedy
description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20...80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
concise: Elite Weapon Spell. (8 seconds.) The next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, this ally steals 20...80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.

name: Wearying Spear
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. You are Weakened for 5 seconds.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. You are Weakened (5 seconds).

name: Wearying Strike
description: Scythe Attack. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, you inflict a Deep Wound for 3...10 seconds. You suffer from Weakness for 10 seconds if an enchantment is not removed.
concise: Scythe Attack. Remove 1 Dervish Enchantment. Removal Effect: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (3...10 seconds). You are Weakened (10 seconds) if an enchantment is not lost.

name: Web of Disruption
description: Hex Spell. Interrupt target foe. For 10 seconds, target foe is hexed with Web of Disruption. When this hex ends, that foe is interrupted again.
concise: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Initial effect: interrupts a skill. End effect: interrupts a skill.

name: Well of Darkness
description: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Darkness for 5...50 seconds. Hexed foes within the Well of Darkness miss 50% of the time.
concise: Well Spell. (5...50 seconds.) Hexed foes in this well have 50% chance to miss. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.

name: Well of Silence
description: Well Spell. Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Silence for 10...30 seconds. Foes within the well cannot use shouts or chants and suffer -1...4 Health degeneration.
concise: Well Spell. (10...30 seconds.) Foes in this well cannot use shouts and chants and have -1...4 Health degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.

name: Whirling Charge
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1...6 seconds, you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10...60 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1...6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...60 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13...20 damage.
concise: Melee Attack. Attacks target and adjacent foes for +13...20 damage.

name: Wielder's Remedy
description: Enchantment Spell. For 10...30 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, that ally loses 2 conditions.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (10...30 seconds.) Whenever you cast a weapon spell, the targeted ally loses two conditions.

name: Wielder's Strike
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...60 lightning damage. If you are under the effects of a weapon spell, you deal an additional 10...50 lightning damage.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...60 lightning damage. Deals 10...50 more lightning damage if you are under a weapon spell.

name: Wielder's Zeal
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10...40 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, you gain 1...5 Energy.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10...40 seconds.) You gain 1...5 Energy whenever you cast a weapon spell.

name: Wild Throw
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +5...20 damage, and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked. All of your non-spear attack skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Unblockable. Ends target's stance.Disables your non-spear attack skills for 3 seconds.

name: Winds of Disenchantment
description: Spell. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. If an enchantment was removed, all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.
concise: Spell. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.

name: Words of Comfort
description: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20...65 Health and an additional 20...50 Health if that ally is suffering from a condition.
concise: Spell. Heals for 20...65. Heals for 20...50 more if target ally has a condition.

name: Wounding Strike
description: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you do +5...20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Elite Scythe Attack. Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds). Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Xinrae's Weapon
description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20...80 Health from that foe.
concise: Elite Weapon Spell. (8 seconds.) The next time target ally takes damage from a foe, that damage is limited to 5% of target ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20...80 Health from that foe.

name: Zealous Anthem
description: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses an attack skill, that ally gains 1...8 Energy.
concise: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...8 Energy with their next attack skill.

name: Zealous Benediction
description: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 30...180 Health. If target was below 50% Health, you gain 7 Energy.
concise: Elite Spell. Heals for 30...180. You gain 7 Energy if target ally was below 50% Health.

name: Zealous Renewal
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes take 5...30 holy damage. For 5...25 seconds, you have -1 Energy regeneration and gain 1 Energy whenever you hit a foe. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you gain 1...5 Energy.
concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (5...25 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 5...30 holy damage to nearby foes. You have -1 Energy regeneration and gain 1 Energy when you hit. Gain 1...5 Energy if this enchantment ends early.

name: Zealous Vow
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1...6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.
concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You gain 1...6 Energy each time you hit with an attack. You have -2 Energy regeneration.

name: "By Ural's Hammer!"
description: Shout. For 30 seconds, all dead party members in earshot are resurrected with full Health and Energy. Resurrected party members deal 25...33% more damage. When this effect ends, affected party members die. This skill does not incur a death penalty.
concise: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal 25...33% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.

name: "Dodge This!"
description: Shout. For 16...20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14...20 damage.
concise: Shout. (16...20 seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +14...20 damage.

name: "Don't Trip!"

concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...20 spirit (30...90 second lifespan). Heals party members in earshot for 3...10 each second. Healing cost: this spirit loses 3...10 Health.

name: Sadist's Signet
description: Signet. You gain 10...45 Health for each condition on target foe.
concise: Signet. You gain 10...45 Health for each condition on target foe.

name: Shadow Fang
description: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 10 seconds, this hex does nothing. When this hex ends, you return to your original location and that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. End effect after 10 seconds: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds); you return to your original location.

name: Shell Shock
description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...30 lightning damage and has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes adjacent foes.
concise: Spell. Deals 10...30 lightning damage. Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration. If Overcast, strikes adjacent.

name: Shield of Force
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1...16 seconds, blocks the next 1 attacks against you. If an attack is blocked, all adjacent attacking foes are knocked down and suffer from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1...16 seconds.) Blocks the next 1 attacks against you. Knocks down and inflicts Weakness (5...20 seconds) on all adjacent attacking foes.

name: Shrinking Armor
description: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe suffers from -1...4 Health degeneration. When this hex ends, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Causes -1...4 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Signet of Deadly Corruption
description: Signet. Target foe takes 5...35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).
concise: Signet. Deals 5...35 damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe.

name: Signet of Distraction
description: Signet. If target foe is casting a spell, that spell is interrupted and disabled for 1...5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.
concise: Signet. Interrupts a spell. Interruption effect: target foe's spell is disabled for 1...5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.

name: Signet of Infection
description: Signet. If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
concise: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition (13...20 seconds) if target foe is Bleeding.

name: Signet of Mystic Speed
description: Signet. For 30 seconds, your next 1...3 self-targeting enchantments cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.
concise: Signet. (30 seconds.) Your next 1...3 self-targeted enchantments cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.

name: Signet of Pious Restraint
description: Signet. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds. If an enchantment was removed, all foes in the area of your target are also Crippled and this signet recharges 75% faster.
concise: Signet. Inflicts Crippled condition (5...15 seconds). Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: also causes Cripple to foes in the area of your target and recharges 75% faster.

name: Signet of Recall
description: Signet. For 6 seconds, you have -4 Energy regeneration. When this effect ends, you gain 13...20 Energy.
concise: Signet. (6 seconds.) You have -4 Energy regeneration. End effect: you gain 13...20 Energy.

name: Slippery Ground
description: Spell. If target or adjacent foes are Blind or moving, these foes are knocked down. There is a 50% chance of failure with Water Magic less than 5.
concise: Spell. Causes knock-down if this foe is Blind or moving. Affects foes adjacent to your target. 50% failure chance unless Water Magic greater than 4.

name: Sloth Hunter's Shot
description: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +10...25 damage. If that foe is not using a skill, Sloth Hunter's Shot does an additional +10...35 damage.
concise: Bow Attack. Deals +10...25 damage. Deals +10...35 more damage if target foe is not using a skill.

name: Smite Condition
description: Spell. Remove one condition from target ally. If a condition was removed, foes in the area take 10...60 holy damage.
concise: Spell. Removes a condition. Removal effect: deals 10...60 holy damage to foes in the area of target ally.

name: Smiter's Boon
description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your Smiting Prayers have double Divine Favor healing bonus.

name: Smoke Powder Defense
description: Stance. For 8 seconds, the next time you are struck, you take half damage and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 2...6 seconds.
concise: Stance. (8 seconds.) The next time you are struck, you take half damage and inflict Blindness condition (2...6 seconds) on adjacent foes.

name: Smooth Criminal
description: Spell. For 10...20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5...10 Energy.
concise: Spell. (10...20 seconds.) Disables one spell. This skill becomes that spell. You gain 5...10 Energy.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5...8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.
concise: Melee Attack. Inflicts Blindness (5...8 seconds). Counts as a lead attack.

name: Snow Storm
description: Spell. Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30...40 cold damage each second.
concise: Spell. Deals 30...40 cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

name: Soldier's Speed
description: Stance. For 3...18 seconds, you move 15% faster. You move an additional 15% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.
concise: Stance. (3...18 seconds.) You move 15% faster and an additional 15% faster while affected by a chant or shout.

name: Spear Swipe
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage and target foe is Dazed for 4...10 seconds. This attack has melee range.
concise: Spear Melee Attack. Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds). This attack has melee range.

name: Spear of Redemption
description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.
concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.

name: Spiritleech Aura
description: Skill. For 5...20 seconds, all of your spirits within earshot deal 5...20 less damage and steal 5...20 Health when they attack.
concise: Skill. (5...20 seconds.) All of your spirits within earshot deal 5...20 less damage and steal 5...20 Health when they attack.

name: Spotless Mind
description: Enchantment Spell. For 1...15 seconds, target other ally loses a hex every 5 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (1...15 seconds.) Removes a hex every 5 seconds. Cannot self-target.

name: Spotless Soul
description: Enchantment Spell. For 1...15 seconds, target other ally loses a condition every 3 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (1...15 seconds.) Removes a condition every 3 seconds. Cannot self-target.

name: Sum of All Fears
description: Hex Spell. For 4...12 seconds, target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.
concise: Hex Spell. (4...12 seconds.) Target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.

concise: Spell. Summons a level 14...20 Ice Imp that has Ice Spikes (40...60 second lifespan). Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

name: Summon Mursaat
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Mursaat that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
concise: Spell. Summons a level 14...20 Mursaat (40...60 second lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

name: Summon Naga Shaman
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
concise: Spell. Summons a level 14...20 Naga Shaman (40...60 second lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

name: Summon Ruby Djinn
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
concise: Spell. Summons a level 14...20 Ruby Djinn (40...60 second lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

name: Sundering Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. For 4...10 seconds, target ally's next 3 attacks have 10% armor penetration and cause Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Weapon Spell. (4...10 seconds.) Target ally's next 3 attacks inflict Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds) and have 10% armor penetration.

name: Symbolic Strike
description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +12 damage for each signet you have equipped (maximum 70 damage).
concise: Melee Attack. Deals +12 damage (maximum 70) for each signet you have equipped.

name: Technobabble
description: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30...40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3...5 seconds.
concise: Spell. Deals 30...40 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition (3...5 seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.

name: Trampling Ox
description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you a hit a Crippled foe, that foe is knocked down.
concise: Dual Attack. Deals +5...20 damage; causes knock-down if target foe is Crippled. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Tryptophan Signet
description: Signet. For 14...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23...40% slower.
concise: Signet. (14...20 seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack 23...40% slower.

name: Ursan Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear. For 60 seconds, you have 100 armor and 750...800 Health. All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills.
concise: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and 750...800 Health.

name: Vampiric Assault
description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If this attack hits, you steal 10...40 Health.
concise: Dual Attack. Steals 10...40 Health if this attack hits. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Volfen Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and 2...4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.
concise: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and 2...4 Health regeneration.

name: Volley
description: Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +1...10 damage if they hit.
concise: Bow Attack. Deals +1...10 damage. Hits up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. All your preparations are removed.

concise: Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Interrupts target foe's next attack. Interruption effect: 30...110 damage to nearby foes.

name: Ward of Weakness

concise: Ward Spell. (5...20 seconds). Inflicts Weakened condition (5...20 seconds) to any foes that take elemental damage in this ward.

name: Waste Not, Want Not
description: Spell. If target foe is not casting a spell or attacking, you gain 8...13 Energy.
concise: Spell. You gain 8...13 Energy if target foe is not attacking or casting a spell.

name: Way of the Master

concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) While holding a non-dagger weapon, you have +3...33% chance to land a critical hit.

name: Weakness Trap
description: Trap. When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10...20 seconds and take 24...50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

quests: Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon

concise: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 24...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition (10...20 seconds). Knocks-down Charr. Easily interrupted.

name: Weapon of Aggression
description: Weapon Spell. For 5...15 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
concise: Weapon Spell. (5...15 seconds.) You attack 25% faster.

concise: Weapon Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Target ally gains 1...7 Energy the next time this ally hits with an attack skill.

concise: Well Spell. (5...30 seconds.) Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds) to any foe in the well that takes physical damage. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.

name: Winds

concise: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Creates a level 4...10 spirit (54...90 second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.

name: Winter's Embrace
description: Hex Spell. For 2...6 seconds, target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5...15 damage while moving.
concise: Hex Spell. (2...6 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5...15 damage while moving.

name: Withering Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness condition (5...20 seconds.)

name: Zealous Sweep

concise: Scythe Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and 1 adrenaline for each foe you hit.
